description: Revoke an agent session. This immediately halts all further execution on the backend (the execute path only runs ACTIVE sessions). The on-chain session remains installed until the user completes the uninstall in the Moneda app, but no payments can be made through it in the meantime. Use this when the agent is done with the mandate or the user asks to stop it.

sessionId.description: The agent session id to revoke.

name: revoke_agent_session
